response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS healtheval, SUM(sc.scancount) AS total_scancount, SUM(sc.gbsize) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sc.spanmin), 0) AS gb_per_min FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), a AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_min) AS avg_rate FROM g) SELECT g.healtheval, g.total_scancount, g.gb_per_min, g.gb_per_min - a.avg_rate AS rate_minus_avg FROM g CROSS JOIN a WHERE g.gb_per_min > a.avg_rate

assumptions.assumption: Scans with a NULL healtheval on a matched site form their own group, which counts as a status. Its rate is included in the average across statuses.
A status whose spanmin sums to 0 or NULL has a NULL rate. It is ignored in the average and excluded from the output.
The average across statuses is the unweighted mean of the per-status rates.
